# Table A1: cost of every experiment

Nearest-rank p50 and p95 over each group's rows (03 §13.3); wall time per case and method, peak RSS of the run in MiB (per_case.csv peak_rss_mb), LLM tokens of AI arms. No committed file records the machine of these runs (bench_manifest has no host field; docs/team/*.md lists the laptops); the slowest laptop's measurement, which H5 is read against, is Table 8c. Replayed AI arms have no run cost; the recorded model time and tokens are Table 8b. Slate-scored causatrix methods have no cost by design (04 §12 row of 2026-11-21). Every experiment YAML is listed; one that does not list `cost` is n/a. In calibration-fit experiments with held-out restarts (crossfit2, loso), a held-out run's wall time includes its calibration run.
